from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's quarterly filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period, format YYYY-MM")
    net_income_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label for net income/loss (e.g., 'Consolidated Net Income', 'Net Loss')")
    net_income_value: float | None = Field(description="Net income/loss amount; losses should be negative")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    depreciation_amortization_label: str | None = Field(description="Line item label for depreciation and amortization adjustment")
    depreciation_amortization_value: float | None = Field(description="Depreciation and amortization adjustment amount")
    depreciation_amortization_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
